message: standardize variable names & created mega sheet for all counties
standardize HI and round data to 2 decimal points

info.long_name: Number of students enrolled
info.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
info.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} students were enrolled.

info.long_name: Number of students with a valid immunization certificate
info.short_description: Number of enrolled students with a valid immunization certificate.
info.long_description: Students with any valid certificate on file: a certificate of immunization, a provisional certificate, or a medical or religious exemption certificate. This is a compliance measure, not a coverage measure: exempt and provisional students count as valid. Alabama's "not expired certificate" and Iowa's "total valid certificates".
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students with a valid immunization certificate.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a valid immunization certificate
info.short_description: Proportion of enrolled students with a valid immunization certificate.
info.long_description: Students with any valid certificate on file: a certificate of immunization, a provisional certificate, or a medical or religious exemption certificate. This is a compliance measure, not a coverage measure: exempt and provisional students count as valid. Alabama's "not expired certificate" and Iowa's "total valid certificates".
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students with a valid immunization certificate.

info.long_name: Why rate_valid_certificate carries no value on this row
info.short_description: Whether rate_valid_certificate was published as a number, suppressed, not reported, or censored at a bound.
info.long_description: Per-measure companion to rate_valid_certificate. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.
info.statement: In {location}, rate_valid_certificate was {value}.

info.long_name: Number of students with a medical vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Number of students with a religious vaccination exemption

info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious vaccination exemption

info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

flag_partial_religious_exempt_utd.long_description: Per-measure companion to rate_partial_religious_exempt_utd. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.

al_school_immunization.name: Alabama School-Entry Immunization Data
al_school_immunization.description: County-level school-entry EXEMPTION data from the Alabama DPH school-entry survey, for kindergarten, 7th and 9th grade. ADPH reports four categories: full medical, partial medical where the student is otherwise up to date, full religious, and partial religious where the student is otherwise up to date. It publishes no coverage, so the coverage columns are empty. MAPPING ONTO THE STANDARD COLUMNS -- Alabama has no philosophical or personal-belief category, and the standard columns are currently filled as: rate_medical_exempt = full medical only (partial medical is excluded, and is available separately as rate_partial_medical_exempt_utd); rate_personal_exempt = full religious; and rate_full_exempt = full religious. The last two mean rate_full_exempt, rate_personal_exempt and rate_full_religious_exempt all carry the same number, so an any-reason exemption total for Alabama is NOT available in rate_full_exempt -- it excludes medical exemptions entirely. Sum rate_full_medical_exempt and rate_full_religious_exempt for a full-exemption total. This mapping was set by an explicit request rather than derived, so it is recorded here rather than silently changed.
al_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
